Repo outputs `vis42.mcpb` (MCP Bundle) installable in Claude Desktop one-click. Bundle includes Node.js stdio→HTTP proxy forwarding MCP ops to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`. Proxy must answer Claude Desktop `initialize` immediately; remote connection is deferred (lazy on first request).  
async `getRemoteClient()` must return existing `remoteClient`/`connectPromise`; set `connectPromise=(async()=>{/*connect,set remoteClient*/})()`; setRequestHandler `ListToolsRequestSchema` to `const client=await getRemoteClient(); return await client.listTools(req.params);` (never block startup): never call `await connectToRemote();` in startup.  
Transport constructors never throw. Errors surface only when `client.connect()` is awaited. SSE fallback must wrap the `connect()` call: `const transport=new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(url,{requestInit:{headers}}); await client.connect(transport); log(...) ; const sseTransport=new SSEClientTransport(url,{requestInit:{headers}}); await client.connect(sseTransport);` (constructors never throw; wrong code/catch never activates).  
All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel. Define `const log=(msg)=>process.stderr.write(\`[vis4
